body.name: Comp_rho
body.def: \(\operatorname{Comp}_s(\rho)\) is the set of tuples obtained from source-to-sink suffix paths extending \(\rho\) in the mode-\(s\) graph; unsuperscripted \(\operatorname{Comp}\) denotes the published mode.
body.role: Completion semantics for full-lattice or q-pruned prefixes.
